Comment: Document intelligence (ADR 0045, open question 41): one execution per landed contract document. Started by EventBridge when a document's landing manifest is written (pipeline_manifests/public_contracts/contract_documents/), or by hand with {"document_id": "..."}. Runs Textract + Bedrock extraction in the task runner as the AI extraction role, queues the result for human review, and notifies the reviewer. Approval, Silver and Gold stay human-driven (make ai-decide, then dbt). A document already extracted from the same PDF with the same prompt and schema is skipped (a repeated S3 event costs nothing).

Retry.Comment: A non-zero exit: most likely Bedrock throttling when several documents land together. The extraction is idempotent per document (skip-extracted).

CheckExitCode.Comment: A second safeguard: a non-zero exit already fails the task state (ADR 0029, observed live).

Parameters.Subject: ProcureLake dev: contract extraction ready for review
Parameters.Message.$: States.Format('Document intelligence execution {} finished for {}. If it was not already extracted, it waits in the review queue: make ai-review STATUS=pending_review, then make ai-decide (ADR 0032). Nothing reaches Silver or Gold until a reviewer decides.', $$.Execution.Name, $.label)

Parameters.Subject: ProcureLake dev: contract extraction failed
Parameters.Message.$: States.Format('Document intelligence execution {} failed for {}. See the task log (/procurelake/${runner_name}) and the audit prefix audit/ai_extraction/ in the artifacts bucket. Runbook: docs/runbooks/pipeline-alarms.md', $$.Execution.Name, $.label)

BadInput.Cause: Expected an S3 Object Created event (detail.object.key) or {"document_id": "..."}.

ExtractionFailed.Cause: The extraction task did not exit 0 or did not start (see the task log and the audit prefix).
